title: After Caleb Williams' fourth INT, Jaylon Johnson nabs pick-six off Baker Mayfield

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: After Caleb Williams' fourth INT, Jaylon Johnson nabs pick-six off Baker Mayfield
sources.description: Though they didn't score off a blocked punt in the third quarter, the Buccaneers did get another takeaway with a fourth interception off Caleb Williams.
